title: 1957 UFOs head toward Eisenhower's summer White House
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 1957 UFOs head toward Eisenhower's summer White House, about September 1957 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: UFO researcher Brad Sparks thoroughly documented a UFO heading towards Eisenhower's summerh home in 1957

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a UFO researcher named Brad Sparks has carefully documented a UFO heading toward the summer home of President Dwight Eisenhower in September 1957. According to Michels, the case rests on records from NORAD, the US and Canadian air defence command, and from Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, and if true it would mean an unknown object approached where the president was staying.
